# AuthCallbackPage

The page Spotify and TIDAL send you back to after sign-in: it shows progress, then says you are connected or what went wrong.

`SongNodes.AuthCallbackPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.AuthCallbackPage provider="spotify" phase="checking" onRetry={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.AuthCallbackPage" provider="spotify" phase="checking" on-retry="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (AuthCallbackPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` * | `"spotify" \| "tidal"` | From the route: /callback/spotify or /oauth/callback (TIDAL). |
| `phase` * | `"checking" \| "saving" \| "connected" \| "error"` |  |
| `account` | `string` | Account name returned by the service, shown on success. |
| `error` | `{ title: string; text: string }` | Plain-language reason; never raw codes or tokens. |
| `autoReturnSec` | `number` | Seconds before returning to Settings after success (default 2). |
| `onRetry` * | `() => void` |  |
